work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory records, checked incoming deliveries against purchase orders, and referred discrepancies to the appropriate staff for resolution.
Prepared routine order paperwork, organized shipment documents, and coordinated collection schedules with warehouse staff and delivery contacts.

projects.title: Handwritten Digit Classification with Linear Baselines
bullets: Implemented logistic regression and linear support vector machine baselines using scikit-learn, with normalized grayscale pixels as input features.
Compared classifiers on a held-out test split using confusion matrices, and inspected misclassified images for recurring ambiguities in digit shapes.
